mapper.insert: INSERT INTO social_media_items (platform, image, caption, url, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{platform}, #{image}, #{caption}, #{url}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE social_media_items SET platform = #{platform}, image = #{image}, caption = #{caption}, url = #{url}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE social_media_items SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE social_media_items SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM social_media_items WHERE platform = #{platform}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM social_media_items WHERE image = #{image}
SELECT id, platform, image, caption, url, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at FROM social_media_items ORDER BY platform ASC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, platform, image, caption, url, sort_order, status, created_at, updated_at FROM social_media_items WHERE platform = #{platform} AND status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
